knowledge.purpose: Renders a data-bound array as N uniform items when the count is only known at runtime: built-in 'card' (icon/avatar grid) or 'row' (a vertical list: avatar, title+subtitle, trailing badge/CTA) layouts fed by items, or children as an item TEMPLATE ({{item.Field}}) that needs a block-level "repeat": "{{source}}".
useCases: An external list rendered as announcement/news rows (layout 'row' with headingField/subtitleField)
App launcher tile grid from a data source (layout 'card' + compact + minCellWidth)
Directory/people list with avatarField and trailing badge counts
antiPatterns: Fixed, small, known-count content — compose blocks statically or copy a template snippet instead
Tabular data with comparable columns — a repeater repeats one card-shaped template; it has no column headers
Single featured item — bind {{source[0].Field}} expressions directly into content blocks

Children with {{item.*}} and no block-level "repeat" — putting the source in props.items does NOT expand a template; the children render once outside any item (one ghost row). The block draws nothing in that case and the pack gate rejects it. Write "repeat": "{{source}}" on the repeater itself.
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- Arbitrary per-item composition via children item-template ({{item.Title}}) when the two layouts don't fit

TEMPLATE MODE REQUIRES repeat: {"type":"repeater","repeat":"{{products}}","children":[{"type":"text","props":{"content":"{{item.name}}"}}]}. `items` feeds only the built-in card/row layouts. A single record bound to items is shown as a list of one.

While loadingWhen is true a shimmer skeleton shows; errorWhen with a message shows a quiet error shape. In template mode the field-mapping props are ignored; `repeat` is a sibling of props, not a prop.

jsonSchema.description: 'card' = responsive tile grid; 'row' = a vertical list, one item per line (stacked top to bottom), each row with a leading avatar/icon, title+subtitle and a trailing badge/CTA; 'inline' = the items wrap as chips on as many lines as they need (tags, categories) — each chip shows headingField and links to ctaHrefField; with template children (repeat) the clones wrap the same way, so a repeated badge becomes a chip row. gap sets the space between chips.
Item field rendered as the title. HTML in field values is stripped to plain text.
Item field rendered as the body/description text (card layout).
Item field rendered as the secondary line (row layout).
Item field whose value is an image URL rendered as the leading avatar/icon image (falls back to iconField/iconDefault).
Item field whose value picks the leading icon (see iconMap).
Maps iconField values to icon names from the shared icon set.
Fallback icon name when no avatar/icon field resolves.
Item field rendered as a trailing badge/count pill (row layout).
Item field whose value is the trailing CTA label (row layout).
Fixed trailing CTA label applied to every item (alternative to ctaLabelField).
Item field whose value is the CTA link href.
Visual variant of the trailing CTA button/link.

Card layout only. 1 (default) = one item per line. Any value above 1 turns the card grid into auto-fit: as many cells per line as fit at minCellWidth — the width decides the count, not this number. Lower minCellWidth for more cells per line.
Auto-fit minimum tile width in px for the card grid (small values give app-launcher style tight grids).
Card layout: centered icon + small label tile look (app launcher).
Gap between items in px.
Renders at most N items (field-mapping layouts only; the children item-template renders the full array).
Quiet text shown when the bound array resolves empty.
Bind to {{__loading.<sourceId>}} — true renders a shimmer skeleton instead of items.
Bind to {{__errors.<sourceId>}} — a non-empty message renders a quiet error shape (message in tooltip).
